message.content:
Velvet-blazer, tailored fit, knee-length hem, deep midnight blue (#0F1830), heavy-weight wool blend with subtle sheen.
Satin-cummerbund, relaxed wrap, hip-length cut, electric teal (#00E5FF), smooth silk-chiffon mix.
Silk-shell-dress, bias-cut silhouette, midi length ending mid-calf, rich burgundy (#800020), liquid satin with a faint woven damask pattern.
Leather-pumps, classic stiletto heel, ankle-high shaft, charcoal grey (#36454F), polished nappa leather.
Gold-tone-chains, delicate links, short pendant resting at collarbone, 18k gold-plated brass, lightweight metal mesh.
Cashmere-capelet, loose drape, elbow-length sleeves, silver-grey (#C0C0C0), soft brushed cashmere for warmth against the frost.

This ensemble balances festive vibrancy with the sophisticated atmosphere of a New Year's restaurant celebration, using rich jewel tones and metallic accents to stand out during winter festivities. The velvet blazer and capelet provide essential warmth against the frosty weather without appearing bulky or restrictive. A relaxed silk cummerbund adds movement and visual interest at the waist, softening the structured tailoring of the outer layers. Overall, the outfit honors your wish for glamour while respecting the cold conditions, ensuring you feel both stylish and comfortable throughout the night.
